The central Turin location is supported by very high proximity percentiles for healthcare, education, commercial services, green areas, and public transport. The supplied data do not establish capacity for 15 people, room layout, or authorization for hourly childcare. The cited regional entry gives a verified net standard of 4 sqm per child and a separate minimum of 60 sqm net useful area for the facility; neither establishes gross-area sufficiency on its own. It also flags a regulatory transition and required planning, building, health, accessibility, safety, and sector authorization checks. Confirm the regime applicable when applying before concluding feasibility.
